text:
```yaml
name: Prerelease CLI

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v2
      with:
        node-version: '16'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: npm install

    - name: Run tests
      run: npm test

    - name: Build TypeScript
      run: npm run build

  sonarqube-scan:
    needs: build-and-test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v2
      with:
        node-version: '16'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: npm install

    - name: Run SonarQube scan
      uses: SonarSource/sonarqube-scan-action@v7
      with:
        args: "-Dsonar.projectKey=AgentWorkforce_relay"
        projectBaseDir: .
        scannerVersion: latest
        scannerBinariesUrl: https://binaries.sonarsource.com/Distribution/sonar-scanner-cli/sonar-scanner-cli-4.5.0.2216-linux.zip
        skipSignatureVerification: true

  deploy:
    needs: build-and-test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v2
      with:
        node-version: '16'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: npm install

    - name: Build TypeScript
      run: npm run build

    - name: Deploy to staging
      run: |
        # Add deployment logic here
        echo "Deploying to staging..."
```

This GitHub Actions workflow file `.github/workflows/prerelease-cli.yml` is designed to perform the following tasks:

1. **Build and Test**:
   - Checks out the code.
   - Sets up Node.js.
   - Installs dependencies.
   - Runs tests.
   - Builds TypeScript code.

2. **SonarQube Scan**:
   - Depends on the build and test job.
   - Checks out the code.
   - Sets up Node.js.
   - Installs dependencies.
   - Runs a SonarQube scan to detect issues in the codebase.

3. **Deploy**:
   - Depends on the build and test job.
   - Checks out the code.
   - Sets up Node.js.
   - Installs dependencies.
   - Builds TypeScript code.
   - Deploys the application to a staging environment (placeholder step).

Make sure to replace the placeholder deployment logic with actual deployment steps suitable for your project.
